text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Champions Cup. Moving from Ohi to 
Chukyo, Round 2 vs. Crimson Nova."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Last time, they had just returned 
from an overseas campaign and a layoff.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
However, this time—she should be in 
absolute peak condition.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, her condition is clearly a cut 
above.

Yeah, the conditioning is clearly 
superior.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of the difference in experience, 
facing an opponent on the rise means a 
hard fight is inevitable, but—
choice_data_list: Even so, let's hang in there somehow!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Last time, they didn't even pay 
attention to me, but this time—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I will make them realize. That 
Funabashi—is not to be underestimated."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I guess... it's about time.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click, clack, click, clack)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ms. Crimson!

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Um~... to cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're in a tough spot, aren't you...? 
Still, do your best.

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
A tough spot... I don't think anyone else 
sees it that way, though...

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: ――You understand?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I know. Because I...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Because I'm an umadol.

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: Umadol...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because I always get on stage 
sharing the same feelings as Crimson-san. 
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think any Central dirt Umamusume would 
understand at least a little.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here they come! Crimson Nova, and 
Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Round 2 of the ace showdown between 
Central and Local. What kind of race will 
unfold this time!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(As always... those eyes aren't looking at 
me at all...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Are you saying an Umamusume from 
Funabashi amounts to nothing? But...!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I won't let myself be looked down upon 
forever. In fact, the more they look down 
on me...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(We will become stronger. We will build 
upon this frustration— and surpass you, 
without fail!)
